====================================================================
TASK 1 — Publish the 4 Iron Mountain subsidiary profiles (optional 
but recommended for this sprint)
====================================================================

Currently Iron Mountain is is_published: true but its three acquired 
brands are still is_published: false. This creates a gap: readers 
who search for "ITRenew" or "Wisetek" or "Regency Technologies" 
individually find no profile, even though the acquisition data is 
correctly wired in the CMS.

Please flip these four to is_published: true in the Payload admin:

  - itrenew                 (Iron Mountain subsidiary, 2021)
  - wisetek                 (Iron Mountain subsidiary, 2024)
  - regency-technologies    (Iron Mountain subsidiary, 2024)
  - cascade-asset-management (Sage Sustainable Electronics subsidiary, 2025)

Each of these has:
  - A valid parent_company relationship FK already wired
  - An acquisition group with acquired_date, announcement_url, 
    subsidiary_status, and acquired_entity_notes populated
  - No data quality flags (they're not in the sparse-data set)

The subsidiary profile pages will render the M&A context from the 
acquisition group automatically once is_published is true. This gives 
us per-brand SEO URLs without duplicating content.

====================================================================
TASK 2 — Do NOT publish the 8 quality-flagged vendors yet
====================================================================

These 8 vendors have data_quality_flags set and remain is_published: 
false intentionally:

  sparse_data: true
    - paladin-envirotech
    - unduit
    - liquid-technology
    - dynamic-lifecycle
    - cohen-recycling (also awaiting_re_verification: true)

  awaiting_re_verification: true
    - sage-sustainable-electronics
    - iron-mountain (flag set, but already published — this is fine; 
      the flag triggers the amber notice on the existing public profile)
    - cohen-recycling
    - blue-star-recycling (also bot_protection_limited_crawl: true)

  bot_protection_limited_crawl: true
    - blue-star-recycling

These stay unpublished pending an editorial review pass. The 
ProvenanceFooter code is ready to render the amber "About the 
information on this page" notice when they're eventually published — 
that's verified. Before flipping any of them to published, they 
need editorial sign-off that the sparse/unverified data is 
acceptable to publish with the amber disclosure footer attached.

Xen will coordinate the editorial pass separately. You do NOT need 
to do anything with these 8 right now. This is just a note so you 
don't inadvertently flip them during task 1 or future cleanup.

```bash
echo "=== QUALITY-FLAGGED VENDORS (must remain unpublished) ==="
for slug in paladin-envirotech unduit liquid-technology dynamic-lifecycle cohen-recycling sage-sustainable-electronics iron-mountain blue-star-recycling; do
  result=$(curl -s --max-time 15 \
    -H "Authorization: users API-Key d91793cd-9535-480e-b2fa-4f0b4c2cc8ec" \
    "https://cms.compareitad.com/api/vendors?where%5Bslug%5D%5Bequals%5D=${slug}&limit=1" \
    | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
docs=d.get('docs',[])
if docs:
    v=docs[0]
    dqf=v.get('data_quality_flags',{})
    flags=[k for k,val in dqf.items() if val and k!='editor_note']
    print(f\"{v['slug']}: is_published={v['is_published']} flags={flags}\")
else:
    print('NOT FOUND: $slug')
" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "  $result"
done
```
